_doc: Gauntlet mode (P4-03): seven computer commanders in order, each a faction, an AI personality (game/data/ai/personalities.json), a difficulty and a map. Beat one to face the next. Call signs only: they are fictional commanders.

commanders.intro: Viper throws everything at you before your factories are warm. Hold the first rush.
Bastion digs in behind bunkers and air defense. Break the wall before the big wave comes.
Circuit researches everything and fills the sky with aircraft. Bring anti-air.
Glacier fights by the book in the pine forests. No tricks, no mistakes.
Ferryman holds the canal. Three bridges, and every one of them is covered.
Hammer storms the old town street by street. Fast, relentless and well supplied.
Zero is the last commander. Hard, patient, and never short of credits.
